Description

? ? ? (or Infused Ink) is a material that can be obtained by exposing forged Inkstone to a spore projectile shot by a Mysterious Mushroom.

? ? ? Is a part of the quest for obtaining the Uncertain Pickaxe, which involves placing the ? ? ? on the Key pedestals.

Appearance

  • ? ? ? emits unique cubic particles with a faint checkered pattern resembling a Missing Texture placeholder.
  • Both the refined and forged forms of ? ? ? share the same material with their Inkstone counterparts with the only difference being that they are now colored hot pink and have a bright glow emanating from them.

Trivia

  • One of the loading screen tips reads "Ink is the new pink", which is alluding to this ore.
  • ? ? ? emits purple square checkerboard particles, which vaguely represent the famous Missing Texture checkerboard.
  • When a player inspects a schematic filled with ? ? ?, it will instead be called "InfusedInk" as opposed to "? ? ?".
